label: Copy phase, fed-back input is 1/a/y/w, mid-to-late recall in long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (98% of mass, plus a little at <DEL>); never during the original-input phase. It is token-selective on the fed-back input: 1 (42% of mass, 11.6x lift), a (24%), y (16%), w (7.5%); those four tokens cover about 89% of mass. It strongly prefers later recall positions (recall_idx >= 3; almost silent at recall 0-2) and long sequences (L = 9 holds 66% of mass, never at L <= 4). The strongest activations are at recall_idx 3-4 or 7-8 of L = 9 sequences, e.g. 1 or a fed back at step 12-17. Rate also rises with the number of digits in the sequence. Precision is low: most copy-phase steps with these tokens at late positions stay below threshold, and I found no history variable that cleanly separates them. Dev F1 is about 0.46 with mass recall 0.77.
